regions.region: title, abstract, and blue graphical-abstract panel
regions.finding: Current-work generic cis-1,2-digermylation and regioselective allene hydrogermylation are overviewed; these repeat later tables and were not counted as duplicate concrete experiments.

Two Pd prior-work routes and the current generic Au/TiO2 route are shown; the adjacent continuation also cites a Pt(acac)2 prior-work result. Prior work is classified as literature_example, not as this paper's experiment.
Background and citations only; no additional current concrete experiment was identified.

unresolved: The prior-work scheme does not identify concrete substrate structures or measurement bases in this paper.
Graphical-abstract yield ranges are overview values and are not assigned to a new concrete experiment.

regions.finding: Seventeen independent substrate-scope entries were transcribed with Au/TiO2 loading, digermane equivalents, DCE, 70 °C, time, isolated yields, and footnote overrides. The 3o E/Z mixture is separated into two molecular identities.

regions.region: Table 1 footnotes b-d and adjacent propargyl-alcohol prose
regions.finding: 3f uses 2 equiv digermane for 4 h; 3o has Z/E 75/25; a separate 2.5-equiv propargyl-alcohol variant forms 3q/3q' about 1:1 and 3q' about 50%.

Au/Al2O3, Au/ZnO, 0.1 mol% Au/TiO2, and unenumerated internal-alkyne failures are discussion/context. The explicit Ph3PAuNTf2 5 mol%, 70 °C, 24 h, 5% result is retained as a control/optimization experiment.

regions.finding: Eleven independent hydrogermylation entries were transcribed. Rows 6a-6e retain exact internal/terminal ratios; 6g-6i retain the prose >99% statement; 6j and 6k retain both products and their 20/80 and 66/34 distributions.

Four author-proposed mechanistic pathways were retained as proposed_mechanism records: generic digermylation, generic hydrogermylation, the 4j conjugated branch, and the 4k H2-elimination branch. They are not experimental records.
Four concrete Pd2dba3/AgBF4/DMF coupling combinations were separated by substrate/aryl iodide, with 3 equiv aryl iodide, 5 mol% source notation, yields, and three-product ratios where shown.

The 1.5-equiv aryl-iodide experiments producing isolable monoarylated intermediates in about 25-30% relative crude yield begin here and continue on page 4; evidence is merged into the 9a/9c records rather than duplicated.

4f/6f and the dense 4j/6j/6j'/6k/6k' drawings remain without asserted complete SMILES.
Scheme 3 does not report time, temperature, scale, workup, purification, yield basis, or ratio method.
The combined catalyst notation does not state a separately apportioned AgBF4 loading.

regions.finding: 9a is assigned E by NOESY/HMBC; 9c is isolated as a single E isomer. These statements complete the monoarylation records begun on page 3.
The branching Pd diarylation mechanism is an author proposal and is retained as one proposed_mechanism record, not as observed elementary experiments.
Isolated 9c is treated with Pd2dba3/AgBF4 and 1.5 equiv p-fluoroiodobenzene, yielding the same 8c-gem/8c-cis/8c-trans ratio as Scheme 3; this is a separate mechanistic-study experiment.
